outcome: Maternal complications (aortic dissection, uterine rupture, postpartum hemorrhage, preterm delivery)
cohort: 20 pregnancies in 13 women with LDS from 8 specialist UK centers
finding: Women with LDS experience a high rate of obstetric complications, particularly postpartum hemorrhage and preterm delivery, requiring multidisciplinary care and early elective preterm delivery consideration.
mod_finding: The majority of deliveries (78%) were by elective cesarean section, at a median gestational age of 37 weeks, likely due to the perceived risks associated with LDS.
gest_age: Median gestational age at delivery: 37 weeks
